# Open a build pod's step worktree

**Schema**: pij/procedure · **Source**: procedure.dd.json · **Sections**: 15

## Meta

| --- | --- |
| id | PROC-pods-0001 |
| title | Open a build pod's step worktree |
| area | pods |
| kind | runnable |
| status | current |
| owner | project-manager |
| updated | 2026-11-26 |
| summary | Make the step's branch in its own worktree off the base, then record that folder as the pod's work-folder so `pij pod down` records where the step stands. The shipped build pod names it as its up procedure. |
| superseded_by | — |

| who | The build pod's project manager, or whoever ran `pij pod up`. |
| when | Right after `pij pod up shipped:build`, from the repo's main checkout, with `--key pod-&lt;pod&gt;` (the pod's name is read from the key). |

<a id="done-when"></a>
